statement: theorem sum_vectors_succ (T : ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) : (∑ v : List.Vector Bool (T + 1), f v.toList) = ∑ v : List.Vector Bool T, (f (false :: v.toList) + f (true :: v.toList))
